verdict.rationale: Background automations, such as scheduled jobs, triggers, or recurring tasks, are a fair axis for a database platform, but the evidence documents none. `helix chef` is described as an interactive, one-shot bootstrapper for scaffolding and agent setup. It is not an automation that runs autonomously or recurringly in the background, so it earns no credit. The MCP endpoint, CLI, and SDKs are developer building blocks rather than a background automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
